description: This source file defines classes that implement stream queue mapping strategies based on consistent hashing (hash ring). It includes the main class HashRingBasedStreamQueueMapper for mapping queues onto a hash ring, and a derived class HashRingBasedPartitionedStreamQueueMapper for mapping partitions to specific queues via hash ring. The classes facilitate load balancing and partitioning of stream data in a distributed Orleans streaming system.

classes.name: HashRingBasedStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Implements a stream queue mapper that distributes queues across a hash ring, providing methods to get queues for a range, all queues, and responsible queue for a stream.

classes.name: HashRingBasedPartitionedStreamQueueMapper
classes.description: Extends HashRingBasedStreamQueueMapper to track specific partition mappings to QueueIds, facilitating partition-to-queue resolution.

methods.name: GetQueuesForRange
methods.description: Returns the list of QueueIds that fall within the specified ring range.

methods.name: GetAllQueues
methods.description: Returns all QueueIds in the hash ring.

methods.name: GetQueueForStream
methods.description: Determines the responsible QueueId for a given StreamId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the hash ring.

methods.name: QueueToPartition
methods.description: Returns the partition identifier for a given QueueId.
